source_caption_data.pre_caption: This video is presented as a static full shot. Initially, a person is crouching in the lower center of the frame, positioned in the middle ground between several tree trunks that occupy the foreground and middle ground. The person then stands, moving vertically to the center of the frame and shifting slightly deeper into the middle ground behind a central tree. They then hold a smartphone in the center of the frame, and after activating its flashlight, raise the phone from their midsection toward the upper-center of the frame. While the subject is crouching, the camera is positioned above them; as the subject stands, the camera becomes level with them, though the camera's physical position does not change.
